eyebrow: Two very different speeds of GPU-to-GPU traffic

steps.label: PCIe Gen4 x16
steps.sub: ~32 GB/s, shared, routes through the CPU

steps.label: NVLink 4
steps.sub: ~900 GB/s per GPU, direct, bypasses the CPU

eyebrow: Every GPU, a direct path to every other GPU

steps.label: NVSwitch
steps.sub: full-bandwidth path between any two GPUs

eyebrow: A first look at nvidia-smi topo -m
code:
$ nvidia-smi topo -m
        GPU0   GPU1   GPU2   GPU3
GPU0     X     NV12   NV12   NV12
GPU1   NV12     X     NV12   NV12
GPU2   NV12   NV12     X     NV12
GPU3   NV12   NV12   NV12     X
caption: NV12 means an NVLink path; PHB would mean routed through the PCIe host bridge
